paragraphs.text: Jinno Terimund was a craftsman from the Kingdom of Shikar on Corondor ( Dominaria ). He fell in love with Chondaeh .

Being a patriot, he managed to travel through the southern reaches of the Great Sulgh Salt Marsh and enter the Kingdom of Khone , where he discovered the Khonians wanted Gydolien Mor to control the Scarzam Dragon she would summon . Instead of giving it to Sol'Kanar the Swamp King , they would use it to kill Sol'Kanar and overrun Shikar . He was revealed to be a Shikaran, and escaped with poisoned arrow wounds; he died in the arms of Chondaeh, telling her the Khonians’ plans and asking her to stop the coming danger.
